parentage.anchor: original LLaDA low-confidence, steps=128, gen_length=256, block_length=32
parentage.explorer: one conservative symmetric-attention accuracy trajectory, tau=0.004, no forced budget fill
parentage.why_not_v15_only: fresh same-host GSM8K showed that fast/accuracy-only selection lacks the original trajectory and regresses despite substantial candidate-oracle headroom

one_rule.horizontal: generate exactly one original anchor and one symmetric accuracy explorer
one_rule.vertical: for every block containing final-token disagreements, mask only those disagreements and score both complete alternatives once under the anchor external context and once under the explorer external context
one_rule.selection: select the explorer only if its aggregate disagreement log-probability is strictly higher in both external contexts; otherwise return the complete original anchor

allowed: the two generated draft token sequences

development_status.all_public_benchmarks: repeated-use development data; no slice is claimed as an independent clean holdout
development_status.gsm8k_full1319: already consumed by the v15 failure and post-hoc candidate-coverage audit before this registration

rapid_gate.stage_one: HumanEval-32 must strictly beat a freshly generated original baseline with positive paired balance; GSM8K-64 must not regress against the fresh same-host original baseline
rapid_gate.stage_two: MATH-50 and MBPP-100 must each not regress against fresh same-host original baselines
rapid_gate.aggregate: the four development slices must have a strict aggregate correct-count gain, clean stable ids, prompt/target hashes, zero residual masks, and total NFE no more than 2.50x original
rapid_gate.failure: reject without inspecting any additional candidate outputs or changing this registered rule

strict_confirmation.trigger: only after every rapid gate passes
strict_confirmation.protocol: fresh simultaneous baseline and exactly this one candidate on HumanEval-164, MATH-500, GSM8K-1319, and MBPP-500; alternating GPU assignment; separate fixed-NFE fast comparator
strict_confirmation.acceptance: per-task accuracy non-regression and strict aggregate correct-count gain with runtime token-input, source, evaluator, prompt, target, id, mask, NFE, offline-artifact, model-weight, and leakage audits
strict_confirmation.interpretation: confirmatory reuse of public benchmarks, not a clean hidden holdout
